name: H na Oisha-san
source:
A somewhat naughty doctor has come to take medical examinations.
He is supposed to inspect their bodies, but all he's doing is touching the young girls all over.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039687.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位有点调皮的医生来检查身体。
他应该检查她们的身体，但他所做的只是触摸这些年轻女孩的全身。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039687.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
